title: vpc-healthgate-smoke-load-suite
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define and implement a post-deploy health orchestration suite for Private (VPC) deployments. The suite ("healthgate") will run after Terraform applies and validate API readiness, model load behavior, and critical smoke checks. This ticket covers the orchestration, thresholds, CI integration, and runbook for automated remediation/fallback when checks fail.
acceptance_criteria: A healthgate orchestration job is invokable from CI (GH Actions) and as a standalone CLI in the infra repo
API readiness check verifies control plane and inference API respond within threshold and return stable 200/OK on /healthz and /v1/info endpoints
Model load test can load a customer-configured model (default: tiny-open-7b) within 180s and respond to a small inference request under latency SLO
Smoke suite validates routing (private -> dedicated fallback not applicable in VPC) and that KV cache and batching configs are non-empty
Failure of any critical check marks the deployment as FAILED in the Terraform pipeline and uploads logs/artifacts to the deployment job
Runbook entries and mitigations exist and are linked in the job output
test_plan: Step 1: Terraform apply (private-vpc module) – outputs: load_balancer_ip, control_plane_endpoint, kube_namespace
Step 3: API readiness: GET /healthz, GET /v1/info, auth handshake with provided client cert / token
Step 4: Model load smoke: POST /v1/models/{model}/load then poll /v1/models/{model}/status until 'ready' or timeout
Step 5: Inference smoke: POST /v1/generate with short prompt, concurrency=1, max_tokens=64, assert success and latency metrics
Step 6: Load soak (optional): spawn 10 concurrent minimal requests for 60s and assert p95 latency < 2x baseline
Step 7: Capture GPU memory, CPU, disk pressure and logs from agent pods; push artifacts to deployment job
runbook: If /healthz fails: collect control-plane logs (controller, reconciler), verify DNS and certs; rerun certificates' rotation; escalate to infra-oncall
If model fails to load within 180s: check model artifacts path, container image pull errors, kernel failure logs; attempt single retry; if repeated, mark deployment FAILED and ticket SRE-PRIORITY
If inference latency p95 > threshold: reduce concurrency, increase model-variant to quantized fallback, or scale up pod count; record decision in deployment notes
If disk or GPU memory > 90%: scale nodegroup or reduce default max_batch_size; if OOM kill observed, pin model to a smaller quant/type
updates: 2026-03-05: Created ticket. Spike completed on health endpoint contract (Claire Huang). Decided to standardize on /healthz and /v1/info for readiness.
2026-03-07: Prototype healthgate CLI pushed in infra/healthgate with basic /healthz and token auth checks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/487
2026-03-09: Added model-smoke-runner script (python) that posts load requests and polls model status. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/216
2026-03-10: Eng review: Miguel suggested increasing model load timeout to 180s and including GPU memory snapshot. Updated test_plan accordingly.

2026-03-12: QA ran suite against staging-vpc-03. Two failures observed: model load sometimes timed out on first try due to lazy cache warm; added single-retry with 30s backoff. Putting ticket In Review for consolidation.
mitigation_steps: automated: retry model load once with 30s backoff and record logs
automated: if p95 latency breached, reduce batch_size and re-run quick smoke
manual: open SRE triage, collect traces, escalate to infra-engineering for kernel/quant issues
manual: rollback Terraform to previous working module version and pin model variant
notes: We intentionally avoid tight coupling to Terraform lifecycle hooks; healthgate runs as a separate CI job that reads TF outputs. This simplifies retries without failing apply mid-terraform.
For on-prem installs the CLI will accept --kubeconfig to run checks inside the target cluster for cases where control-plane endpoints are private.
Future: add a synthetic prompt suite (prompt-regression) to detect generation quality regressions post-upgrade; scoped separately due to eval infra dependencies.
